project_title: WhatsApp Atendimento SaaS - Omnichannel Customer Support Platform

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-50
hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider

layout_strategy.sidebar: Fixed narrow icon + text bar on left (64px collapsed, 220px expanded) for core module navigation
layout_strategy.inbox_list: 320px fixed column for active chat list, search, filters (Unassigned, Mine, All, Tags)
layout_strategy.main_chat_thread: Flex-1 dynamic chat area with header, scrollable audio/text transcript, quick reply bar, and multimedia rich sender area
layout_strategy.crm_panel: 300px collapsible right sidebar for contact CRM details, call recordings, agent assignment, notes, custom fields, and tags

key_components.name: Conversation Inbox
key_components.description: WhatsApp chat stream with realtime message delivery statuses, voice message player wave visualizer, file attachments, and emoji picker.

key_components.name: Chatbot & Automation Builder
key_components.description: Rule-based and AI trigger config for keywords, welcome greetings, out-of-office hours, and automated menu routing.

key_components.name: Quick Replies & Templates
key_components.description: Categorized message template manager with variable replacement badges (e.g. {{nome}}, {{protocolo}}).

key_components.name: Call Logs & Audio Recordings
key_components.description: Audio player interface with speed controls (1x, 1.5x, 2x), transcript view, call duration, and agent notes.

key_components.name: Agents & Team Management
key_components.description: Attendant list, active workload status, queue assignment rules, and role management (Admin vs Attendant).

key_components.name: Contacts CRM
key_components.description: Filterable contact list with tags (VIP, Lead, Inadimplente, Suporte), contact history, and WhatsApp sync status.

key_components.name: Analytics Dashboard
key_components.description: Key metrics (Avg Response Time, CSAT score, Messages/day, Attendant Leaderboard) using Recharts with dark palette.

key_components.name: WhatsApp Connection Center
key_components.description: QR code scanner canvas simulation, session status (Connected / Reconnecting), device phone details, and webhook health.

motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for incoming message toasts with quick answer triggers

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, message inputs, filter tabs, modal triggers) MUST contain descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, production-ready WhatsApp Omnichannel Customer Atendimento Dashboard in Portuguese with English tech fallback.
Implement Role-Based view switching (Admin mode showing full analytics/bot settings vs Attendant mode focused on Inbox).
Ensure three-pane chat view works seamlessly on desktop and degrades gracefully to collapsible panels on mobile screens.
Use Lucide React icons for all operational metrics, chat status ticks (double green checkmarks), voice wave indicators, and channel badges.
Ensure data-testid is attached to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and key list items as per testing requirements.
